content: संहिता .²1 Combination, union, conjunction. .²2 A collection, compilation, compendium. .²3 A ny systematically arranged collection of texts or verses. .²4 A compendium or compilation of laws, code, digest; मनुसंहिता. .²5 The continuous hymnical text of the Veda as formed out of the Padas or individual words by proper phonetic changes according to different Śākhās or schools; पदप्रकृतिः संहिता <ls>Nir.</ls> .²6 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Combination or junction of letters according to the rules of Saṃdhi or euphony; परः संनिकर्षः संहिता <ls>P. I. 4. 109</ls>; वर्णानामतिशयितः संनिधिः संहितासंज्ञः स्यात् <ls>Sk.</ls>; or वर्णानामेकप्राणयोगः संहिता. .²7 The Supreme Being who holds and supports the universe.
